name: cart-paper
description: CART Paper — a social reading and writing platform with passage-anchored discussion.

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && npm run setup
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.makemigration: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.db.seed
scripts.shell:db: docker compose exec db psql -U cart -d cartpaper
